_about: W11-2: the NVD CPE products (part:vendor:product) that name the same thing as a CPE nmap -sV prints. nmap's service database keeps old vendor names (nginx is igor_sysoev:nginx to nmap, f5:nginx in NVD since F5 bought it, nginx:nginx before), so without this an exposed nginx is never compared with the exploited CVEs listed under F5. Read by cmd/vedette/exposurematch.go (nmapAliases); checked by TestNmapAliases_DataIsValid.
